background: BACKGROUND: the one and only background is a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure magenta field (exact color #FF00FF) that fills the entire canvas right up to the subject's edges. Do not draw any backdrop, panel, board, poster, placard, card, rectangle, stripe, grid, halo or platform behind the subject, and do not place the subject on any coloured shape. The magenta background must be perfectly even: no gradient, no vignette, no noise, no texture, no shadow, no reflection, no border.
